name: osa-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker for OSA security proxy
_comment_wrangler: Pinned exactly, not a caret range (#442). This repository ignores JS lockfiles by design, so package.json is the only place a version can actually be fixed. wrangler's defaults are version dependent: a [[routes]] table flips workers_dev to false, and that already took the workers.dev hostname down once during #437, with clean deploy output. A floating range reintroduces that class of silent regression on some future date with no code change. Bump deliberately, and redeploy dev first.
